args.title: checkout-api memory pressure causing OOMKilled and pod restarts (ALR-oom-01)
args.body:
Alert ALR-oom-01 for service checkout-api: Pods restarting with memory usage >95%.
Fired at 2026-10-01T10:00:00+00:00.
Observed evidence:
- Memory percentage rising from baseline 55% to 98% over 1h; p95 latency up to 320ms; error_rate% rising from 0.3% to 4.0%.
- 5 pod restarts reported; logs show repeated OOMKilled (exit code 137).
- Heap usage reported at 91% of container limit (1024Mi).
- Recent deploy: v1.0.3 on 2026-09-28 (routine dependency bumps).

Initial hypotheses: memory pressure leading to OOMKilled, possible memory leak or misconfiguration after last deploy.
Recommended immediate action: increase memory limits/requests for checkout-api pods or scale to larger nodes to accommodate memory until stability is restored. Monitor memory, restarts, and error rate after change. If instability persists, consider rolling back to a previous stable version or analyzing heap leaks.

args.title: checkout-api /pay errors likely due to payments-gateway timeouts (dependency timeout)
args.body:
Alert ALR-dep-01 for service checkout-api fired at 2026-10-01 10:00 UTC with recurring failures on /pay.

Evidence:
- Metrics 1h window show error_rate_pct rising from baseline 0.3% to 7.0% and p95 latency from 200ms to 5200ms (6 points: 200, 1200, 2200, 3200, 4200, 5200).
- Logs show two ERRORs: 'call to payments-gateway timed out after 5000ms' at 09:51 and 09:58 UTC.
- No pod restarts (0); last deploy v1.0.3 on 2026-09-28 with routine dependency bumps.
- Runbook for high_error_rate suggests checking metrics, logs, recent deploys, and escalating with a ticket.

Likely cause: dependency_timeout due to upstream payments-gateway timeouts causing downstream errors on /pay.

Recommended next step: perform a targeted health check on the payments-gateway path to confirm timeout/root cause, collect latency/timeout metrics, and coordinate with the payments team to address upstream availability or configure retry/backoff as needed.
